description: This file defines a command class for synchronizing LDAP users within the OrangeHRM system. It handles configuration, execution of the sync process, error handling, and logging of sync status.

classes.name: LDAPSyncUserCommand
classes.description: A command class extending the base Command to handle LDAP user synchronization in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the command used in CLI: 'orangehrm:ldap-sync-user'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the command description to 'Sync users from LDAP'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the LDAP sync operation: checks settings, starts sync, handles exceptions, and logs status.
